title: Cottage Cheese Bowl with Granola & Berries
description: Cottage cheese layered with toasted granola, mixed berries, honey and cinnamon.
steps: Spoon the cottage cheese into a bowl as the base.
Layer half the granola, all the berries, then the rest of the granola on top.
Drizzle with honey, dust with cinnamon and scatter over the almonds.

source.label: Adapted from BBC Good Food high-protein breakfast collection

notes: Cottage cheese's casein protein digests slowly — this holds you longer than a yogurt bowl of the same calories.
